covers.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Generate a landscape 3:2 abstract comic-book collection cover for a premium poster shop. Pure abstract graphic art: overlapping torn scarlet and cobalt paper, cream halftone dots, energetic radial ink lines, thick black contour strokes, an amber light accent. Sophisticated tactile collectible print aesthetic against warm charcoal. Crisp geometric composition readable at small card size. No characters, people, faces, masks, franchise symbols, logos, text, letters, watermarks, or room furniture. Do not depict a specific superhero. Output only the finished artwork.
